finding: More spatial detail did not restore reliable unseen-family forward prediction. Correct-action wins were 8/12 but the mean margin favored the wrong action, and predicted pair effects were far smaller than observed effects.
limitations: This is exploratory and was collected after the failed frozen 16x16 unseen-family result.
The 64x64 and 16x16 studies differ in seeds and training sample counts, so their win-count difference is not a controlled estimate of resolution effect.
Only selected one-step public browser click pairs were evaluated; no real desktop, multistep, autonomy, safety, or Jev-parity claim.
